description_en: Queries the backup list of a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) cluster instance
description_zh: 查询云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）集群实例的备份列表
name: DescribeClusterBackupList

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473763.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 实例所属的地域ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473763.html接口获取
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.

Valid values:

30
50
100
200
300
5
10
15
20
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC. The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，必须晚于查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to show backup set information for shards in the instance.

true: does not show backup set information for shards in the instance.
false (default): shows backup set information for shards in the instance.

Valid values:

True
False
parameters.help_zh:
是否展示集群节点的备份集详情：
false（默认）：展示集群节点的备份集信息。
true：不展示集群节点的备份集信息
parameters.name: no_shard_backup
